landing.hero_lead: The Million Dollar Mission is a live test of that question—starting with the people, places, resources, and possibilities already present.
landing.hero_title: What becomes possible when a community can see and connect what it already has?
landing.create_body: Turn connected contributions into useful outcomes that can be seen, reviewed, and carried forward.
landing.connect_body: Make people, needs, skills, places, relationships, and resources visible to one another.
landing.core_premise: The resource is not just the money. The resource is the community.
landing.question_body: People, places, resources, organizations, funding, projects, and needs may already exist in the same community. The Million Dollar Mission tests what changes when those parts can become visible to one another and move together through clear participation.
landing.capacity_title: Communities already contain more potential than any one person or institution can see alone.
landing.question_title: What becomes possible when the connections work?
landing.contribute_body: Give people a clear way to bring time, knowledge, money, tools, labor, property, creativity, or care into a shared effort.

terms_document.title: Terms of Site Use & Participation

sections.body: Public pages are informational and may describe c3 initiatives, environments, publications or participation opportunities. Viewing a page, playing media or following a public presentation transition does not create standing, partnership, ownership, governance rights or an investment relationship.
sections.heading: Public site use

sections.body: A c3 relationship is not created merely by clicking Connect. Where a Connect process requires consent, confirmation, verification or persistence, the relationship has only the standing actually established by that process.
sections.heading: Connecting

sections.body: Participation may involve explicit agreements, permissions, environment boundaries or initiative-specific conditions. Those specific conditions control where they apply.
sections.heading: Participation

sections.body: Participant-supplied content remains the participant's unless an explicit applicable agreement establishes different rights. Submitting content does not silently grant c3 unlimited commercial, ownership or derivative rights.
sections.heading: Participant-supplied content

sections.body: Site use or ordinary participation does not by itself create equity, securities, investment returns, ownership of c3 Community Partners DAO, LLC, ownership of community property, DAO governance rights, or entitlement to funding or distributions. Any such right requires a separate explicit applicable instrument or agreement.
sections.heading: No automatic financial or governance rights

sections.body: c3 may hold, restrict, correct, suspend or prevent an encounter from advancing where operation would exceed permission, misrepresent standing, expose information improperly, or otherwise conflict with governing system conditions.
sections.heading: System boundaries

sections.body: c3 aims to represent current governed state accurately, but public information may change as projects, initiatives and operating conditions change. No public page is a guarantee that a proposed initiative, property, funding source, participant opportunity or project outcome will occur.
sections.heading: Accuracy and availability

sections.body: c3 Community Partners DAO, LLC is the legal operating entity. c3Field is the relational operations environment. The c3 Community Partners brand and c3Field environment do not independently become separate legal entities merely through presentation.
sections.heading: Legal distinction

privacy_document.intro: c3 Community Partners DAO, LLC operates c3Field.
privacy_document.title: Privacy & Data Handling

sections.body: c3Field may process information a participant intentionally provides, including name, email address, Connect messages or responses, consent, accuracy attestation and participation-intention records, and information subsequently supplied within an authorized c3 environment. c3Field may also process limited technical and security information required to operate the service, including session identifiers, request metadata, delivery or verification records, and security or operational logs.
sections.heading: Information collected

sections.body: Information is used to process an intentional Connect request, send confirmation or continuation messages, resolve and operate an authorized participant environment, maintain permissions, session continuity and security, preserve governed evidence and operational records, and support participant-requested c3 activity.
sections.heading: How information is used

sections.body: Participant information is not treated as advertising inventory. c3 may use infrastructure and service providers where needed to operate c3Field, deliver messages, store governed records or secure the service. Provider custody or processing does not by itself transfer ownership of participant-supplied content to c3.
sections.heading: Sharing and custody

sections.body: Participation does not, by itself, transfer ownership of participant-supplied content to c3 Community Partners DAO, LLC. Any additional license, transfer or shared-rights arrangement requires an explicit applicable agreement.
sections.heading: Participant content

sections.body: Records are retained according to the applicable operational, evidence, security and legal requirements governing the relevant environment or relationship. A governed record may persist as evidence even when a later relationship or permission changes; persistence does not enlarge the meaning of the record.
sections.heading: Retention

sections.body: A c1ME.env is not automatically public. Public exposure is bounded to information and relations permitted for the applicable encounter.
sections.heading: Public and private boundaries

sections.body: Questions concerning privacy or c3Field data handling may be sent through the Contact page.
sections.heading: Contact
